rules.statement: A person who files an inventory and takes steps to pay estate duty, while claiming to be entitled to probate, may be considered an executor de son tort if the surrounding circumstances indicate an intention to exercise executorial functions.
rules.supporting_quote: Here the inventory was made by a person who said he was entitled to probate, however mistaken he may have been on that point. He told the Court that no one would object to his claim for probate, and that claim, which could only be on the footing that he was executor, was actually allowed by the Court.

meta.parties: Senaratne Et Al. v. Nandias Silva
